connectors.evidence_source: The metadata-linked PersistIQ Swagger UI is live and directly configures its PersistIQ API V1 document at this URL. The artifact declares api.persistiq.com as production, OpenAPI 3.0.1, and an x-api-key header security scheme.
connectors.counting_note: PersistIQ's current provider-hosted Swagger UI links this complete OpenAPI document. It defines 14 paths and 21 HTTP operation objects: 12 GET, 6 POST, 1 PATCH, 1 PUT, and 1 DELETE. GET actions list or retrieve campaign leads, campaigns, DNC domains, events, lead fields/statuses, leads, campaign replies, tags, users, and webhook-plugin settings, so they are reads. All non-GET actions add/remove campaign leads, create/duplicate campaigns, add DNC domains, create/update leads, send a campaign reply, or update webhook-plugin settings; each changes provider or outbound-email state, so there is no semantic non-GET read. Inbound webhook deliveries are excluded; callable webhook-plugin settings retrieval/update is retained.
